title: Spotify ads are 25 percent more effective than average, study says | Campaign US

facts.fact: A Nielsen Catalina Solutions study found that total incremental sales per 1,000 impressions for Spotify ads for 11 major CPG brands were 25 percent higher than average.
facts.quote: the total incremental sales per 1,000 impressions for Spotify ads for 11 major CPG brands was 25 percent higher than average

facts.fact: Spotify's Jeff Rossi said that for every 1,000 impressions Spotify ran, it created $24 of revenue.
facts.quote: For every thousand impressions we ran, we created 24 dollars of revenue.

facts.fact: Spotify's Jeff Rossi stated that the Nielsen benchmark is $19.64 (per 1,000 impressions).
The Nielsen Catalina Solutions study examined ads that ran on Spotify over a 12-month period.
facts.quote: The study looked at ads that ran on the platform over a 12-month period

facts.fact: According to the Nielsen Catalina Solutions study, campaigns that ran on both mobile and desktop saw 39 percent higher incremental sales than campaigns running on just one of them.
facts.quote: campaigns that ran on both mobile and desktop saw 39 percent higher incremental sales over campaigns running on just one or the other.

facts.fact: The Nielsen Catalina Solutions study covered ads for non-alcoholic beverages, food, snacks, personal care and home care products.
facts.quote: promoting non-alcoholic beverages, food, snacks, personal care and home care products.

facts.fact: The article reporting the Spotify ad effectiveness study was published on June 20, 2017.
